synopsis_text: 流沙纪元，风蚀荒漠深处的绿洲「泉眼堡」依靠地下暗河维系；每逢旱季，掠食性沙蚁群循着水汽沿固定方向迁徙，所过之处寸草不留。 The setting is 20×20 开放沙地；西缘蚁穴为敌人出生点，东缘前哨基地为防守目标；三座风驱沙脊（移动沙丘）横亘其中，随风力缓慢位移。. 玩家是泉眼堡的防线工程师「筑垒者」；旱季将至，蚁群循水汽而来——在蚁群与基地之间的开放沙地上用箭塔与沙障塑出一条迂回长路，耗死蚁群。 Core loop: 放塔塑路 → 敌人寻路 → 调整布局 → 重算路径 → 守住基地。. 基地失守=泉眼堡水脉断流（C02 失败意象：沙蚁涌入基地）；守住 5 波=蚁群绕道而走（C02 胜利意象：基地旗帜舒展、蚁群远去）。 Narrative devices: 沙行蚁=荒漠掠食蚁（原创造型）；沙障=夯沙板墙；箭塔=木质弩架；移动沙丘=风驱沙脊；前哨基地=泉眼堡哨站。全部原创，不用商业作品命名。. Art direction: 荒漠军事风；主色＝沙金 #D8B96A、赭石 #A9744F、烈日白 #F5EFE0、警报赤 #C0392B；材质为风化岩、帆布、木制弩架。. Sound direction: 沙漠风啸为底；音效语言＝建造落位/拆除塌落/路径重算提示/蚁啸警报/命中木屑/波次横幅（F06 冻结清单）；混音优先级：基地警报 ＞ 波次横幅 ＞ 命中 ＞ 建造/拆除 ＞ 环境风。. Asset tasks: 6 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 1 motion, 13 audio, 2 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (interact→点击空格＋塔型; interact→点击己方塔＋拆除钮; interact→1/2; interact→Space; pause→Esc; restart→Enter) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.G04:
- G04 寻路与改路（本包冻结值）：
  - 敌人出生点＝西缘中点 (0,9)，基地＝东缘中点 (19,9)；敌人四邻接移动（每步 1 格），路径「格数」按移动步数计。
  - 敌人始终走「出生点→基地」的最短可行路径；等长路径按 BFS 邻居顺序 东→北→南→西 展开取第一条，该条同时作为预览路径与实际路径。
  - **堵死放置非法（红线）**——任何使基地不可达的放置被拒绝且不扣费；有敌人占据或正在进入的格放置非法并拒绝；波中可建可拆。
  - 放置/拆除生效瞬间触发重算：场上敌人从当前所在格（移动中则从下一格）按新的最短路径继续行进。
  - 拆除返还 60%（沙障 30→18、箭塔 50→30），返还不得高于造价（防刷经济断言：建-拆循环净收益恒 ≤0）。
  - 箭塔默认攻击最接近基地的射程内敌人；伤害即时结算（命中帧生效，弹道仅为表现层）。
  - 路径长度 oracle 数例：20×20 空地出生点到基地最短 19 步；在 (10,9) 放 1 沙障后最短 21 步。
context.L04: - L04 冻结需求 vs 实现默认 vs 生成自由度：本 spec 明确写出的数值与数量为冻结需求；未给数值的表现层（装饰造型、配色、粒子）为生成自由度，不得评估为缺失；实现默认值必须明确标注且符合核心机制。音效为冻结需求（F06 清单逐条交付，缺失按 FAIL 计，T6 裁决）。
context.N06: - N06 表现层自由度：未冻结的装饰造型、配色、粒子参数与音色为生成自由度，由 L04 承担，不评估为缺失。

context.S09:
- S09 敌波行进
  - input：系统波调度（fixed_seed=1027 出生序列，每 1.0 秒出生一只）；塔自动交战；玩家仍可建/拆（波中可建可拆，不暂停敌人）
  - precondition：建造期结束（Space 或倒计时归零）
  - state_change：敌人按当前最短路径行进；放置/拆除生效瞬间触发分段重路由（见 §3 G04）；漏怪（抵达基地）→ 基地生命 −1
  - feedback：命中反馈与路径/重路由特效（见 §9 F05/F06）

context.S10:
- S10 波次结算
  - input：系统结算
  - precondition：波内敌人清空或全部抵达基地
  - state_change：波奖励 +40（见 §3 G03）；波号 +1；第 3 波结束时触发沙丘位移（见 §3 G07）
  - feedback：金币数字跳动（见 §9 F05）
  - next_actions：波号 < 5 → 回 S08；波号 = 5 → S12
  - outcome：进度推进；状态保留
context.S11:

  - input：玩家按 Esc
  - precondition：处于 S08/S09 任意玩法阶段
  - state_change：冻结敌人、寻路、塔、波调度与全部计时（见 §3 G05）
  - feedback：暂停菜单（继续/重开/返回菜单）
  - next_actions：Esc 或「继续」→ 返回原阶段；「重开」→ S07；「返回菜单」→ S06
  - outcome：恢复后一切计时从冻结点继续，无副作用
context.S12:
- S12 胜利结算
  - input：系统结算
  - precondition：第 5 波结束且基地生命 > 0（见 §7 V01）
  - state_change：显示胜利结算（路径总长、漏怪数、剩余金币）
  - feedback：胜利全屏特效（见 §9 F05）
  - next_actions：Enter 重开 → S07；返回菜单 → S06
  - outcome：按 §7 V01/V03 判定并结算
context.S13:
- S13 失败结算
  - input：系统结算
  - precondition：基地生命归零（任意波中即时判负，见 §7 V02）
  - state_change：显示失败结算
  - feedback：失败反馈
  - next_actions：Enter 一键重开 → S07；返回菜单 → S06
  - outcome：按 §7 V02/V03 判定并结算（全量重置）
context.V01: - V01 成功条件：第 5 波结束（波内所有敌人被击杀或已抵达基地）时基地生命 > 0 → 胜利结算（显示路径总长、漏怪数、剩余金币）。

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|

| 拆除返还 | 沙尘塌落＋金币飞向 HUD | demolish_refund | 0.3 秒结束 |
| 箭塔击发 | 弩箭拖尾＋命中木屑＋敌人受击闪白 0.08 秒＋伤害飘字 | arrow_shot / ant_hit | 每发即时 |

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 建塔/沙障落位 | 落地尘土＋落地回弹 0.2 秒 | barrier_place | 落位完成 |
| 拆除返还 | 沙尘塌落＋金币飞向 HUD | demolish_refund | 0.3 秒结束 |
| 箭塔击发 | 弩箭拖尾＋命中木屑＋敌人受击闪白 0.08 秒＋伤害飘字 | arrow_shot / ant_hit | 每发即时 |
| 非法放置 | 红格闪烁＋路径断开处闪烁 | placement_blocked | 提示 0.4 秒 |
| 路径重算 | 当前路径流动箭头线；新路径高亮 0.5 秒 | path_reroute | 高亮结束 |
| 敌人死亡 | 碎成沙石消散 | ant_death | 消散完成 |
| 沙丘位移预告 | 提前一波目标格沙流预告高亮 | （常驻视觉，无音效） | 位移发生 |
| 沙丘位移 | 扬起尘暴＋镜头 0.15 秒小幅震动 | dune_shift | 尘暴消散 |
| 漏怪抵达基地 | 基地红闪＋屏幕边缘红晕＋0.25 秒中幅震动 | base_alarm | 闪烁结束 |
| 波开始 | 波次横幅 | wave_start | 横幅收起 |
| 胜负结算 | 全屏特效（胜利/失败双意象） | victory_sting / defeat_sting | 进入结算面板 |
context.F10: - F10 前端界面：标题（开始/设置/退出）→ 建造期 HUD（金币/波次/基地生命/建造期倒计时/下一波敌数与单只 HP/当前最短路径长度/沙丘位移预告高亮，见 I06）→ 暂停面板（继续/重开/返回/设置）→ 结算面板（胜利：路径总长/漏怪数/剩余金币；失败一键重开）；关键状态图标＋文字并用；窗口失焦自动暂停。
context.G01: - G01 统一刻度：金币/HP 为整数；沙地为 20×20 格，坐标 (x,y) 从西北角 (0,0) 起，x 向东、y 向南；塔射程按格计，射程判定按格中心欧氏距离 ≤ 射程；时间用游戏模拟秒（暂停冻结）。
context.G06: - G06 建造期规则（本包冻结值）：每波前建造期 20 秒倒计时，可按 Space 提前开波；建造期 HUD 显示下一波敌数与单只 HP；倒计时归零自动开波。
context.G07: - G07 移动沙丘（本包冻结值）：场上预先标出 3 格沙丘，初始可通行、不可建造，位置由 fixed_seed=1027 冻结；第 3 波结束时沙丘各移至 seed 冻结的相邻格——被覆盖格变为不可通行，原沙丘格恢复为普通可建造格；若被覆盖格有建筑，建筑被掩埋并按造价 60% 返还；位移后全图重算一次路径（沙丘目标格由 seed 保证基地仍可达）；自第 3 波建造期起在地图上高亮预告目标格。
context.I06: - I06 UI 必须显示的状态：金币、波次号、基地生命（按 §3 G01 刻度）；建造期倒计时与下一波敌数/单只 HP（见 §3 G06）；当前最短路径长度实时显示，且当前可行路径实时可视预览（冻结要求，供玩家塑路决策，预览＝实际路径）；沙丘位移预告高亮（见 §3 G07）；悬停建造格显示射程圈与合法性（绿/红，见 §9 F05）。
context.I07: - I07 输入延迟目标：点击到画面反馈 ≤150 毫秒（WebGL 口径，P95，≥30 次采样/类别）。

| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |
